ontology:
Prefix(:=<http://example.org/diff013#>)
Prefix(xsd:=<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>)
Ontology(<http://example.org/diff013>
  EquivalentClasses(:Red DataHasValue(:color "red"^^xsd:string))
  EquivalentClasses(:Primary DataSomeValuesFrom(:color DataOneOf("red"^^xsd:string "blue"^^xsd:string "green"^^xsd:string)))
  DataPropertyAssertion(:color :a "red"^^xsd:string)
  DataPropertyAssertion(:color :b "blue"^^xsd:string)
)
rationale: DataHasValue: a color "red" makes a an instance of Red = DataHasValue(color "red"); b color "blue" does not. Primary = ∃color.{red, blue, green} (DataOneOf data range): "red" and "blue" are both in {red, blue, green}, so a and b are instances of Primary.
